title: Jeju City Tour Bus 2026: 21-Stop Loop, Prices, Timetable and Where to Board (Airport Stop 3)
description: Jeju City Tour Bus guide, checked October 2026: the 21-stop hop-on hop-off loop past Jeju Airport, Dongmun Market and the coastal road, the KRW 12,000 day pass, hourly timetable, Monday closures and the route change from 3 November 2026.
lead: The Jeju City Tour Bus loops around Jeju City: the ferry terminals, Dongmun Market, Yongduam Rock, Jeju International Airport, the rainbow coastal road at Dodubong, Iho Tewoo Beach, the five-day market, Halla Arboretum and the bus terminal. A day pass lets you hop on and off at 21 stops, and you pay when you board. From 3 November 2026 the route and timetable change.
summary: Loop · 21 stops · about 2 hours per loop
09:00–19:30 · hourly, 9 runs a day · last departure 17:00 · closed Mondays
Day pass KRW 12,000 adult / KRW 8,000 child and youth · single ride KRW 5,000 · preschoolers free
Pay when you board (credit card or transport card)
New route and timetable from Tuesday 3 November 2026

routes.name: Loop route (October 2026)
routes.tip: This is the route until 2 November 2026. The route and times change from 3 November, so check the new timetable on the official site. At the airport the bus stops at stop 3.

tickets.name: Day pass
tickets.price: KRW 12,000 adult · KRW 8,000 child and youth · KRW 6,000 disabled and veterans · preschoolers free

priceNote: Prices from the official Jeju City Tour site on 29 October 2026.
howToBook: No booking needed: pay when you board at any stop (credit card or transport card).
Choose the day pass (KRW 12,000) for several stops or the single ride (KRW 5,000) for one trip.
Service may stop in typhoons or heavy rain or snow; call 064-741-8784 to check.
howToRide: At Jeju Airport, board at bus stop 3; you can also board at any of the 21 stops.
Pay as you board and keep your ticket; show the day pass when you reboard.
Get off anywhere and catch the next bus an hour later. The last bus leaves at 17:00.
Pets can ride only in a bag or carrier.

faq.q: Do I need to book the Jeju City Tour Bus?
faq.a: No. Pay when you board at any stop.

faq.q: Can I board at Jeju Airport?
faq.a: Yes, at bus stop 3 outside the airport; the bus passes about every hour.
No, it is closed every Monday.
Hourly, with the last departure at 17:00. Times change from 3 November 2026, so check the official timetable.
